test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The boss of our organisation is considered __a jack of all trades.__

options.text: Doing several different jobs instead of specialising in one

solution: The correct answer is: **'****Doing several different jobs instead of specialising in one****'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"jack of all trades"** means someone who is competent in many skills but may not be a master in any of them. (कई कामों में निपुण व्यक्ति, लेकिन किसी एक में विशेषज्ञ नहीं) • **Example: **John is a **jack of all trades**; he can paint, fix cars, and even cook gourmet meals. • **"Doing several different jobs instead of specialising in one"** refers to engaging in multiple activities without focusing on a single expertise. (कई कामों में लगे रहना बिना किसी एक में विशेषज्ञता हासिल किए) **​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Knowing nothing but boasting** (कुछ न जानते हुए भी डींग मारना): Refers to someone who pretends to have knowledge or skills they do not possess. • **Example:** He is always boasting about his achievements, but in reality, he knows nothing about the subject. • **Engaged in gambling** (जुआ खेलने में लगा हुआ): Refers to someone who is involved in gambling activities. • **Example:** He lost all his money because he was engaged in gambling. • **Innocence about everything** (हर चीज़ के बारे में मासूमियत): Refers to someone who is naive or unaware of many things. • **Example:** Her innocence about everything made her an easy target for scams. 1d1:Tc3d, The correct answer is: Bright.
